stackitup.command.help:
/stackitup show all : list all modified items.
	/stackitup show [item] : show information of a specified item.
	/stackitup show hand [player] : show information about an item on a player's hand.
	/stackitup reset all : revert all changes.
	/stackitup reset [item] : reset a specified item.
	/stackitup reset hand [player] : reset an item on a player's hand.
	/stackitup set [itemID] [count] : set the max stackable count of a specified item.
	/stackitup set hand [player] : set the max stackable count of an item on a player's hand.
	/stackitup set vanilla [default value] [new value] : Apply new value to the stackable size of items whose default size is default value. (Only works for items that haven't been modified.)
	/stackitup set modified [current value] [new value] : Apply new value to the stackable size of items whose current size is current value. (Only works for items that have been modified.)
	/stackitup set all [current value] [new value] : Apply new value to the stackable size of items whose current size is current value. (Applies to all items.)
	/stackitup config reload : Reload config from file.
	/stackitup config loadFromGlobal : load the global config (stored in minecraft's config folder) to your game.
	/stackitup config saveToGlobal : Let your current config to be the global config.
	/stackitup config globalConfigAutoApply [true/false] : whether the global config will be automatically applied to every new game.
	/stackitup config restore : restore to last change 
	Also, if you want to use this mod without OP/cheat, you can manually change "permissionLevel" from 4 to 0 in the config file (in your save folder).
	If you want only stack empty shulkerbox, change the setting manually in the config files (0 -> 1)

stackitup.command.reset_item: The stack size of %s has been reset
